reference.reason: The pinned Rust GPUI reference has no TextField or IME transport, so these cases have no differential reference.

cases.observation: compositionstart/update/end commits the final text once; the browser editor value is not used as a second document
a cancelable final beforeinput is prevented and the following identical edit is accepted exactly once
a non-cancelable IME beforeinput followed by input does not duplicate the committed text
an input event without a preceding beforeinput consumes the duplicate exactly once
Escape and ambiguous empty finalization cancel the composition; ordinary typing still works
the next ordinary character is accepted with or without a keydown after a handled composition
a non-cancelable ordinary beforeinput is inserted by the input fallback, not twice
